title: Social security agreement between the UK and India
text:
The UK and India have agreed a new social security agreement. The new agreement will:

 • determine where workers and employers pay their National Insurance contributions

 • make sure that workers moving between the UK and India pay their National Insurance contributions in only one territory at a time
changeNote: Information on National Insurance contributions for employees from India temporarily coming to work in the UK and UK employees temporarily going to work in India has been updated. The link to the National Insurance Double Contributions Convention (DCC) with India has been updated.
